inj.note: Banks logged three consecutive limited sessions during Week 9 prep. The Saints could choose to activate the left tackle ahead of Sunday's game but will need to free up a 53-man roster spot to do so.

news.h: Saints activate WR Jordyn Tyson, LT Kelvin Banks, cut RB Kendre Miller
news.d: Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. have been activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. return to practice
news.d: Report on Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. returning to Saints practice following the bye week.
